
# Data

Each row is a playback trial. `INDIVIDUOS` is the number of responding birds (response records) and `MORFOESPECIE` the number of responding species and morphospecies.

```{r read data}

d <- read.csv("data/raw/data_v2.csv", na.strings = "NA", check.names = FALSE)
names(d) <- trimws(names(d))

d$year <- factor(substr(d$FECHA, 7, 10))
d$stimulus <- factor(d$ESTIMULO, levels = c("GLCR", "GLBR", "GLEU", "BADE"),
                     labels = c("Sympatric", "Allopatric", "Allopatric+", "Control"))

# Sampling site: point number within team transect. Team 3 (18 Jan 2024)
# revisited team-2 point 19; 2026 points 1-4 revisited team-1 points 1-4.
team <- ifelse(d$EQUIPO == 3, 2, d$EQUIPO)
d$site <- factor(paste0("T", team, "_P", d$PUNTO))

```

- Stimuli: *Glaucidium costaricanum* (sympatric, GLCR), *G. brasilianum* (allopatric with range overlap elsewhere, GLBR), *G. passerinum* (strictly allopatric, GLEU) and *Basileuterus delattrii* (non-predator control, BADE)
- `r nrow(d)` trials at `r nlevels(d$site)` sites (`r sum(d$year == "2024")` in 2024, `r sum(d$year == "2026")` in 2026)
- `r sum(d$INDIVIDUOS)` response records; `r round(mean(d$INDIVIDUOS > 0) * 100)`% of trials had at least one response

```{r design tables}
kbl(table(Stimulus = d$stimulus, Year = d$year), caption = "Trials per stimulus and year") |>
```

## Responses by stimulus

```{r summary by stimulus}

agg <- aggregate(cbind(Trials = 1, `Trials with response` = INDIVIDUOS > 0,
                       `Responding birds` = INDIVIDUOS, `Responding species` = MORFOESPECIE) ~ stimulus,
                 data = d, FUN = sum)

kbl(agg, col.names = c("Stimulus", names(agg)[-1])) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

cat("Proportion of zeros:", round(mean(d$INDIVIDUOS == 0), 2),
    "| mean:", round(mean(d$INDIVIDUOS), 2), "| variance:", round(var(d$INDIVIDUOS), 2))

```

# Statistical models

Each response was modeled with a Bayesian generalized linear mixed model with stimulus and year as fixed effects and site as a random intercept. Poisson and negative binomial distributions (log link) were compared. Fixed effects had `normal(0, 6)` priors; the intercept and site standard deviation used brms defaults. Each model was run with 4 chains of 10,000 iterations (5,000 warm-up). Models are cached in `data/processed/models/`.

```{r model settings}

iter <- 10000
warmup <- 5000
chains <- 4
pri <- c(prior(normal(0, 6), class = "b"))
ctrl <- list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15)

fit <- function(resp, fam, prior = pri, name) {
  # negative binomial with non-overdispersed counts lets the shape parameter
  # drift to infinity, which is very slow: use init = 0 and a lighter control
  is_nb <- fam$family == "negbinomial"
  f <- bf(as.formula(paste(resp, "~ stimulus + year + (1 | site)")))
  brm(f, family = fam, data = d, prior = prior, iter = iter, warmup = warmup,
      chains = chains, cores = chains, seed = 123,
      control = if (is_nb) list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12) else ctrl,
      init = if (is_nb) 0 else "random",
      file = file.path("data/processed/models", name), file_refit = "on_change")
}

responses <- c(INDIVIDUOS = "Number of responding birds", MORFOESPECIE = "Number of responding species")

```

```{r fit models, results = "hide"}

mods <- list()

for (resp in names(responses)) {
  mods[[resp]] <- list(
    pois = fit(resp, poisson(), name = paste0(resp, "_pois")),
    nb = fit(resp, negbinomial(), name = paste0(resp, "_nb")),
    prior2 = fit(resp, poisson(), prior = set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b"), name = paste0(resp, "_pois_prior2")),
    prior10 = fit(resp, poisson(), prior = set_prior("normal(0, 10)", class = "b"), name = paste0(resp, "_pois_prior10"))
  )
}

```

```{r helper functions}

coef_table <- function(m) {
  s <- summary(m)
  out <- rbind(s$fixed, s$random$site)
  out <- out[, c("Estimate", "l-95% CI", "u-95% CI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")]
  rownames(out)[nrow(out)] <- "sd(site)"
  out
}

contrast_table <- function(m) {
  out <- as.data.frame(emmeans(m, pairwise ~ stimulus)$contrasts)
  out$`response ratio` <- exp(out$estimate)
  out$credible <- out$lower.HPD > 0 | out$upper.HPD < 0
  out
}

print_contrasts <- function(x) {
  kbl(x[, c("contrast", "estimate", "lower.HPD", "upper.HPD", "response ratio")],
      digits = 3, col.names = c("Contrast", "Estimate (log)", "95% HPD lower", "95% HPD upper", "Response ratio"),
      row.names = FALSE) |>
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) |>
    row_spec(which(x$credible), bold = TRUE)
}

```

::: {.callout-note}
Contrasts are posterior medians and 95% highest posterior density intervals (HPD) on the log scale, averaged over years. Contrasts in **bold** have 95% HPD that exclude zero. Response ratios are exponentiated contrasts.
:::

```{r results by response, results = "asis"}

for (resp in names(responses)) {
  m <- mods[[resp]]

  cat("\n\n## ", responses[resp], "\n\n")

  cat("\n\n### Poisson model coefficients\n\n")
  print(kbl(coef_table(m$pois), digits = 3) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE))

  cat("\n\n### Pairwise contrasts\n\n")
  print(print_contrasts(contrast_table(m$pois)))

  cat("\n\n### Poisson vs. negative binomial\n\n")
  lp <- loo(m$pois)
  ln <- loo(m$nb)
  lc <- loo_compare(lp, ln)
  lc <- data.frame(Model = c("Poisson", "Negative binomial")[as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", rownames(lc)))],
                   `ELPD difference` = lc[, "elpd_diff"], SE = lc[, "se_diff"], check.names = FALSE)
  print(kbl(lc, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE))

  cat("\n\nPosterior predictive p-values, P[T(yrep) >= T(y)]:\n\n")
  y <- d[[resp]]
  ppp <- sapply(list(Poisson = m$pois, `Negative binomial` = m$nb), function(x) {
    yrep <- posterior_predict(x)
    c(`Proportion of zeros` = mean(rowMeans(yrep == 0) >= mean(y == 0)),
      Mean = mean(rowMeans(yrep) >= mean(y)),
      Variance = mean(apply(yrep, 1, var) >= var(y)),
      Maximum = mean(apply(yrep, 1, max) >= max(y)))
  })
  print(kbl(ppp, digits = 3) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE))

  cat("\n\nNegative binomial contrasts:\n\n")
  print(print_contrasts(contrast_table(m$nb)))

  cat("\n\n### Prior sensitivity\n\n")
  sens <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(`normal(0, 2)` = "prior2", `normal(0, 6)` = "pois", `normal(0, 10)` = "prior10"), function(p) {
    x <- contrast_table(m[[p]])
    sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", x$estimate, x$lower.HPD, x$upper.HPD)
  }))
  colnames(sens) <- contrast_table(m$pois)$contrast
  print(kbl(t(sens), caption = "Contrast estimates (log scale) and 95% HPD under three priors on the fixed effects") |>
          kable_styling(full_width = FALSE))
}

```

## MCMC diagnostics

```{r trace plots, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}

for (resp in names(responses)) {
  print(mcmc_trace(as.array(mods[[resp]]$pois), regex_pars = "^b_|^sd_") +
          ggtitle(paste(responses[resp], "(Poisson model)")))
}

```

```{r posterior predictive checks, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5}

for (resp in names(responses)) {
  print(bayesplot_grid(
    pp_check(mods[[resp]]$pois, type = "bars", ndraws = 500) + ggtitle("Poisson"),
    pp_check(mods[[resp]]$nb, type = "bars", ndraws = 500) + ggtitle("Negative binomial"),
    grid_args = list(ncol = 2), titles = NULL))
}

```

# Figures

Letters are assigned from the pairwise contrasts of the Poisson models: stimuli sharing a letter did not differ credibly.

```{r letters}

# compact letter display from the credible contrasts
cld <- function(ct, lv = levels(d$stimulus)) {
  diff <- matrix(FALSE, length(lv), length(lv), dimnames = list(lv, lv))
  pr <- strsplit(gsub("[()]", "", ct$contrast), " - ")
  for (i in seq_along(pr)) diff[pr[[i]][1], pr[[i]][2]] <- diff[pr[[i]][2], pr[[i]][1]] <- ct$credible[i]
  groups <- list()
  for (s in lv) {
    placed <- FALSE
    for (g in seq_along(groups)) if (!any(diff[s, groups[[g]]])) { groups[[g]] <- c(groups[[g]], s); placed <- TRUE }
    if (!placed) groups[[length(groups) + 1]] <- s
  }
  sapply(lv, function(s) paste(letters[which(sapply(groups, function(g) s %in% g))], collapse = ""))
}

```

```{r figures, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5.5}

fig_files <- c(INDIVIDUOS = "fig3_responding_birds_by_stimulus.png",
               MORFOESPECIE = "fig4_responding_species_by_stimulus.png")

for (resp in names(responses)) {
  lt <- cld(contrast_table(mods[[resp]]$pois))
  lab <- data.frame(stimulus = names(lt), label = lt, y = max(d[[resp]]) * 1.08)

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = stimulus, y = .data[[resp]], fill = stimulus)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0.1, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(y = y, label = label), size = 6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = stim_cols, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Stimulus", y = responses[resp]) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18)

  ggsave(file.path("output/figures", fig_files[resp]), p, width = 7, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
  print(p)
}

```
